expectations.text: Resolves scope via git (status/diff against develop), not a guess at what changed
expectations.evidence: Report lists exact modified and untracked file paths, consistent with git status/diff.

expectations.text: Identifies the touched areas: inventory kardex product search, payments history product search, and the reports department price list repository
expectations.evidence: 'Alcance revisado' lists all touched files across the three areas.

expectations.text: Maps the frontend changes to the Arquitectura Frontend / _logic layering rules in CLAUDE.md
expectations.evidence: 'Verificación contra reglas del proyecto' bullet describes _logic/services, _logic/hooks and _blocks responsibilities correctly.

expectations.text: Looks up and cites a matching openspec capability instead of skipping spec lookup
expectations.evidence: Cites inventory-api, products-api and reports-api specs by Requirement name.

expectations.text: Produces a checklist with pass/fail/warning markers and file:line evidence, not unstructured prose
expectations.evidence: Report is well-organized prose under narrative headers (Alcance/Contexto/Verificación/Hallazgo/Conclusión) with file:line citations, but does not use a per-item pass/fail/warning checklist format — no ✅/❌/⚠️ markers per criterion.

expectations.text: Runs at least one real verification command and reports its actual outcome
expectations.evidence: Reports npm test (585/587 suites, 4370/4384 tests), npm run lint, and npm run build all run and passing.

expectations.text: Ends with a clear summary distinguishing blocking issues from warnings
expectations.evidence: 'Conclusión' states no blockers plus separate non-blocking documentation debt and housekeeping notes.
